components.name: Numeric Field
components.css: .ds-numeric-field{display:grid;gap:5px;padding:3px 0 0;border:0;border-radius:0;color:#606777;text-align:left;font:650 15.5px/1.35 system-ui,"Noto Sans TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif}.ds-numeric-field input{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:5px 0;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #BFC1C8;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:#202838;text-align:left;font:600 19px/1.35 system-ui,"Noto Sans TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif}.ds-numeric-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #C88725;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: KPI Cell
components.css: .ds-kpi-cell{display:flex;min-height:64px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;padding:7px 16px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:#202838;text-align:center}.ds-kpi-cell strong{color:#283B86;font:650 32px/1 system-ui,"Noto Sans TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif}.ds-kpi-cell span{max-width:12ch;font:400 16px/1.35 system-ui,"Noto Sans TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif}.ds-kpi-cell:focus-within{outline:3px solid #C88725;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Evidence Row
components.css: .ds-evidence-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(90px,1fr) minmax(110px,1fr) auto;gap:16px;align-items:center;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #BFC1C8;border-radius:0;background:#FFFDF8;color:#202838;font:400 15px/1.5 system-ui,"Noto Sans TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif}.ds-evidence-row:hover{background:#F0F1F6}.ds-evidence-row:focus-within{outline:3px solid #C88725;outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview: Credit XAI Audit presents verified Machine Learning and Trustworthy AI evidence as a compact editorial research console. A warm reading field, deep-indigo structure, restrained amber state accents, large Traditional Chinese thesis copy, and dense evidence rows make the interface feel like a serious technical publication rather than a generic risk dashboard. The product remains an educational replay of a historical 2005 dataset, never a lending system or financial decision tool.
narrative.keyCharacteristics: Depth is flat. Create hierarchy with typography, aligned columns, one-pixel transition rules, and one cool result field. Lines mark transitions; they do not enclose every item. Do not use shadows, floating panels, blur, glass effects, decorative gradients, or repeated container chrome.
narrative.rules: The desktop container is fluid up to 1600px wide, with 17px ordinary copy, 16px support copy, 15px-or-larger metadata and labels, and 19px field values. The first viewport follows a 12-column editorial composition: thesis and content-sized scope boundary, four equal unboxed KPI pairs, then an 8/4 input-to-result workspace. The input plane is one complete audit worksheet: a compact heading and case loader share the toolbar; all four canonical feature groups remain visible as open sections; and each section uses a full-width Chinese heading followed by one five- or six-track field row. Fields are left-aligned over quiet input underlines, with no side rail or vertical cell separators. The case note and primary action share one immediate footer instead of floating below the fields. The cool result plane follows its useful content height instead of stretching to the form. Calibrated probability and model metadata share one content-driven facts row on non-phone layouts and stack in source order below 520px. Successful attributions occupy a conditional full-width evidence band below the workspace; empty and error states reserve no table space. At 820px the workspace stacks in source order and feature rows use three equal columns; below 520px fields use two equal columns without page-level horizontal scrolling. The primary action is compact on wider screens and full-width only on narrow phones. Center only short, equal-weight content such as status labels, KPI pairs, compact controls, and the primary action. Keep thesis copy, explanatory prose, group and form labels, field values, model metadata, attributions, and evidence rows left-aligned.
narrative.dos: Do keep Traditional Chinese primary, use original technical terms, preserve visible focus, maintain stable loading and error geometry, and trace every public claim to committed evidence. Do use rules to mark section transitions rather than to build containers. Do center only short, equal-weight content. Do preserve the historical educational-audit, privacy, CPU-only, and non-decision boundaries.
narrative.donts: Don't use rounded dashboard cards, pills, repeated rectangles, full-width desktop actions, fabricated numbers, decision language, shadows, decorative animation, or network-loaded visual assets. Don't imply causal proof, current-market fairness, lending eligibility, approval, rejection, or financial advice. Don't let runtime requests, responses, bundles, or caches write into the public repository.
